fraction_provenance: Preserved original deposited biomass DNA module mass; assumption, not a measured organism DNA fraction.
correction_method: Native _get_ratio returns ratios summing to 0.5 after double-strand counting. Native conversion additionally treats base count fractions as per-base mass fractions. Corrected coefficients use double-strand nucleotide mole fractions and one mean polymer residue mass (model dNTP minus exact model PPi), mmol/gDW = 1000 * assumed DNA mass fraction / mean residue g/mol. This transparent external correction is NOT represented as unmodified native BOFdat output.
limits: DNA-only, model formula/protonation convention; negligible polymer end groups ignored; no measured RNA/proteomics/lipids/GAM/NGAM inferred.
